description: Identify the courier behind a tracking number (UPS, FedEx, USPS, DHL Express, DPD, Royal Mail and other national posts) from its format, check the check digit where the carrier publishes one, and return the carrier's official tracking link. Several carriers can match the same pattern; each candidate says whether its check digit passed. It does not read live scan events (carriers serve them only through their own sites or keyed APIs). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: logistics_last_mile_courier
title: Logistics Last Mile Courier
